info.description:
### Welcome to Postman! This is your first collection. 

Collections are your starting point for building and testing APIs. You can use this one to:

• Group related requests
• Test your API in real-world scenarios
• Document and share your requests

Update the name and overview whenever you’re ready to make it yours.

[Learn more about Postman Collections.](https://learning.postman.com/docs/collections/collections-overview/)

{
"title": "SMS EQUIPPED STUDENT MONITORING SYSTEM",
"authors": "Fidel M. Paladan, Apple B. Palermo, Jade B. Bonavente, Jessebel L. Bachiller, Wendy M. Enciso",
"keywords": ["SMS", "Attendance", "Monitoring system"],
"year": "2017",
"abstract": "Nowadays, it could not be denied that the world has been influenced by modern technology. It has dramatically been assisting many people in making their works faster and easier. Their life activities were afforded ease and comfort. King Thomas Learning Academy, the respondents, has been employing the existing traditional attendance system which involved manual monitoring of students' attendance. Monitoring students has been one of the problems of the parents because they had no means to monitor their children after they left their households and thereby was usually apprehensive whether their kids went straight to school, arrived there safely and would go home unharmed.\nThis study is intended to help the teachers, the registrar, and the staff and also the guard to make the transactions, specifically in monitoring attendance, in the school easier. This system would offer an improvement in the security done by the guard of the school and will provide assurance to the parents regarding their children's safety. To help assist in this concern, the researchers developed a system that would help the school in their monitoring of attendance and put parents' minds at rest when it comes to assurance of their children's safety. This study entitled \"SMS Equipped Student Monitoring System\" would like to achieve its goal of automating the management and monitoring of attendance and at the same time to effectively disseminate to parent significant information regarding their kids' school activities. Parents as would have a means to be aware and be informed of the time their children arrived and left the school, the schools could have a reliable and safe records of students' attendance and the students themselves could easily be informed once there would be suspension of and classes and other information such as announcements, reminders and upcoming activities and events."
}
